gloss: to be built, to be constructed

definitions.gloss: to be built, to be erected, to be constructed
definitions.explanation: Used for buildings and structures when they come into existence or stand in a location. An intransitive verb — the building is the subject.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{建|た}った。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{建|た}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Condominiums are being built one after another in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{再建|さいけん}→再建：11743_saiken⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧{期|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{建|た}ったものだ。
examples.english: This temple was originally built in the Kamakura period, but it was rebuilt many times, and the current structure was erected in the Edo period.

notes:
Godan verb ending in つ: {建|た}たない, {建|た}ちます, {建|た}って, {建|た}てば.

USAGE:
An intransitive verb — the building itself is the subject (⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{建|た}つ). The transitive counterpart is ⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (to build something). Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand up) or ⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ (time passes), which use different kanji.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {建|た}つ (intransitive): A building is built / stands
- ⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (transitive): Someone builds a building
